original_question: Jordan plays video games for 2 hours every day. He also has a part-time job where he earns $10 an hour. How much money would Jordan earn in one week if he spent his video game time working instead?
question_template: {name_male, Jordan} plays video games for {num_digit_1, 2} hours every day. He also has a part-time job where he earns ${num_digit_2, 10} an hour. How much money would {name_male, Jordan} earn in {num_text_1, one} week if he spent his video-game time working instead?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 * num_digit_2 * 7 * k   # k is the numeric value of num_text_1 (one→1, two→2, …)
